text:
Getting https://streamish.github.io/ ready to launch, a music server compatible with multiple 3rd party mobile apps and particularly Synology and QNAP. Want to do Plex next but I suspect that's a dead-end since I think you can't directly sign in you have to do it through their website.

Now putting it to personal use and keeping an eye out for issues and rough bits to smooth over.

Built with -

NestJS, Sequelize + SQLite, OpenAPI, and Jest

React, TanStack, Shadcn, and Playwright
